2023 Governance Index Model

Source: R/data.R
gov_index_2023.Rd

Parameters of the model behind the governance index returned as gov_score by get_scores(model = "2023"): a unidimensional graded response model (mirt::mirt) fit to every 501(c)(3) organization that e-filed a full Form 990 for tax year 2023. The 16 GI_* practices enter as ten items: nested practices are summed into ordinal items (financial assurance 0–3, conflict-of-interest policy 0–3, minutes 0–2, pay-setting process 0–2) and the other six are binary. The estimates are placed on a scale with mean 100 and SD 15 among 2023 filers. Fitting code: data-raw/fit-index-2023.R in the package source.

Usage

gov_index_2023

Format

A list with elements:

values

parameter table from mirt::mod2values(), used to rebuild the model with fixed parameters when scoring

items, itemtype

the ten index items, in model order, and their item types ("graded" or "2PL")

bundles

the GI_* practices summed into each item

mu, sd

mean and standard deviation of the 2023 EAP estimates; the index is 100 + 15 * (theta - mu) / sd

year, n

anchor tax year and number of organizations

fit

limited-information fit (RMSEA, SRMSR, CFI, TLI) and empirical reliability

coef

item parameters in IRT form (slope a, thresholds)

mirt_version, fitted

mirt version used and date fitted

See also

get_scores, gov_model_2023.
